artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $B_0, B_1, B_2, \ldots$ denote the Bernoulli numbers, and for $n \in \mathbb{N}$ let
$$H_n = \sum_{0 < j \le n} \frac{1}{j}, \qquad H_n^{(2)} = \sum_{0 < j \le n} \frac{1}{j^2}.$$
Prove or disprove the following: for every prime $p > 3$, the four congruences
$$\sum_{k=1}^{p-1} \binom{2k}{k} \frac{H_k^{(2)}}{k} \equiv \frac{2 H_{p-1}}{3 p^2} + \frac{76}{135}\, p^2 B_{p-5} \pmod{p^3},$$
$$\sum_{k=1}^{p-1} \binom{2k}{k} \frac{H_k^{(2)}}{k\, 2^k} \equiv -\frac{3}{16} \cdot \frac{H_{p-1}}{p^2} + \frac{479}{1280}\, p^2 B_{p-5} \pmod{p^3},$$
$$\sum_{k=1}^{p-1} \binom{2k}{k} \frac{H_k^{(2)}}{k\, 3^k} \equiv -\frac{8}{9} \cdot \frac{H_{p-1}}{p^2} + \frac{268}{1215}\, p^2 B_{p-5} \pmod{p^3},$$
$$\sum_{k=1}^{p-1} \binom{2k}{k} \frac{H_k^{(2)}}{k\, 4^k} \equiv -\frac{3}{2} \cdot \frac{H_{p-1}}{p^2} + \frac{7}{80}\, p^2 B_{p-5} \pmod{p^3}$$
all hold (with the rational expressions interpreted $p$-adically).

artifact.status_search_result: A web search revealed substantial work confirming several of Z.-W. Sun's conjectural congruences involving central binomial coefficients, harmonic numbers, and Bernoulli numbers (e.g., arXiv:1108.1171, arXiv:0911.4433, results in Chinese Annals of Math. Series B), but no specific reference proving or refuting these four supercongruences modulo $p^3$ involving $H_k^{(2)}$ with weights $1/(k\,m^k)$ for $m\in\{1,2,3,4\}$ was located. Status could not be definitively verified.

status_evidence.snippet: Proof of a congruence for harmonic numbers conjectured by Z.-W. Sun.
status_evidence.claim: Some of Sun's harmonic-number congruence conjectures have been proved, but this specific one was not located.

status_evidence.title: Open conjectures on congruences (Sun's list)
status_evidence.snippet: Nanjing Univ. J. Math. Biquarterly 36 (2019), no. 1, 1–99.
status_evidence.claim: An updated catalog of Sun's conjectures exists; the precise current status of Conjecture A94 was not confirmed in search results.
